current_behavior_summary: The previous implementation only made minor numeric style adjustments. Visual inspection shows the page still looks bulky and close to the original: card has too much empty space, form still looks like a backend form, and the language selector feels detached.
implementation_steps: Preserve all existing bindings and functionality: locale/changeLocale, username/password v-model, login button click/loading/disabled behavior, t(...) calls, and privacy notice.
Redesign the template hierarchy into a compact SaaS login card: subtle privacy notice, clean brand/header area, stacked form fields, primary login button, and natural language switcher placement.
Change the form from horizontal label/input layout to stacked labels above inputs if the current script bindings can be preserved.
Reduce excessive inner blank space: use a compact max-width around 400-440px and balanced card padding.
Make inputs visually refined: natural height around 40px, consistent radius, focus state, and clean spacing.
Make the language selector subtle and integrated, preferably in the card header or compact footer, not floating awkwardly with too much empty space.
Improve responsive behavior for mobile: no horizontal scroll, no overlap, no clipping, and compact padding.
Do not add new features, new dependencies, new routes, new API calls, or new i18n keys.
logic_contracts_to_preserve: Do not modify the script block.
Do not change login API calls.
Do not change auth store usage.
Do not change i18n key names.

execution_strategy.reason: This is a non-deterministic UI redesign requiring template and scoped CSS changes while preserving bindings.

requirement_gap_summary: The UI must be redesigned with a stronger modern SaaS visual hierarchy, not just small spacing changes.
